The [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] '''''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle''', also known as the '''''Theta''-class T-2c Personnel Transport''', was a tri-winged personnel [[Transport/Legends|transport]] craft, most often used by influential [[Senator/Legends|senators]], officers, and courtiers to travel between [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] while maintaining high levels of security.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> Newly appointed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] used one to save the maimed and burned [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] from the volcanic world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Theta_ICS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Cross-section of Palpatine's ''Theta''-class shuttle.]]
The ''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle was produced by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]]. It's long wings projected powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] fields, which were used for both defense and added stability in atmosphere. In flight, the lower two wings were extended to either side of the shuttle, but during landing, the wings folded up to bracket the hull and concentrate shield energy on the main body. The ''Theta''-class transport was both fast and agile thanks to its powerful sublight engines. It also had an internal Class 1 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] could not rely on speed alone, however, while transporting important dignitaries between worlds. Thus, it was equipped with twin forward-mounted [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] and a high-powered tail gun. Both the quad and standard [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] could be computer-controlled or operated manually from a combined communications and gunnery station in the reinforced cockpit. Upon landing, the shuttle computer surveyed the area for potential dangers, ready to open fire at enemies in an instant. The shuttle could accommodate about five crew members, though it could be flown by a single experienced [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

Palpatine's own T-2c was upgraded by [[Warthan's Wizards/Legends|Warthan's Wizards]], the best starship technicians in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the time. The Wizards added a hyperwave reflector for trans-galactic communication that rivaled the quality of the secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] homing devices. Palpatine's shuttle also featured sensor masks to hide whatever secrets the shuttle's interior held from conventional scanners. During flight, Palpatine's shuttle was often escorted by elite [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighters]] that were upgraded to be equipped with internal hyperdrives and improved shields.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

==History==
[[File:RebelTheta-GaW.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A ''Theta''-class shuttle used by the Rebel Alliance]]

''Theta''-class shuttles were observed [[990 BBY|ten years after]] the end of the [[New Sith Wars]] and were at that time considered new. The class would go on to see service in the centuries leading up to the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DB:ROT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

One was used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to pick up [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal's]] broken body after his shuttle crash accident, right before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEOR" /> Another was used by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as a personal transport when attending to off-world matters during the Clone Wars. The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] who flew the ship wore specially fully sealed [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suits]] with round [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] that fully enclosed the wearer's face, as to be better prepared for combat. The same suit was also worn by the clone pilots of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> One ''Theta'' shuttle was also used to transport a group of Republic agents to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Solidarity (Venator-class)|''Solidarity'']], so that they could be given an assignment by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ezar Elasra]].<ref name="GAW" />

Not long after his [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration]] founding the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the newly-christened [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine used his shuttle on a [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|top secret mission]] to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Piloted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kagi/Legends|Kagi]], the T-2c shuttle reached Mustafar in time for Palpatine to rescue his dying apprentice, Darth Vader, formerly [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. During the return trip to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Emperor made use of the shuttle's onboard medical facilities to treat Darth Vader's wounds prior to a more extensive reconstruction at a [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|medical facility]]. The shuttle also acted as a mobile command base, with various [[Torture/Legends|torture]] devices and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] potions for interrogations.<ref name="ROTS" /> In the first weeks after the Clone Wars, Vader used a black version as his personal shuttle until it was destroyed during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Invasion of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

Though the ''Theta''-class shuttle served the Empire and Palpatine well, it was later replaced by the more advanced [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class]]. Even so, ''Theta''-class shuttles were still used by the Empire as support vessels,<ref name="SOTG07" /> alongside older models like the [[Kappa-class shuttle|''Kappa''-class shuttles]].<ref name="ROE:TRSFHB">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> Following the dissolution of the Senate, many of the senators' ''Theta''-class shuttles were sold off and converted to freighters. Some were bought by collectors who valued the classic design or were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Emperor's shuttle was clearly designed as a harbinger to the ''Lambda''-class shuttles seen in the original trilogy. The tri-wing design was made less angular, with a less aggressive cockpit to soften the obviousness of its role as a villain's transport. The only practical element of the shuttle constructed was its boarding ramp, which was shot against greenscreen for the scene of Emperor Palpatine emerging with Anakin Skywalker's charred body on Coruscant.

In [[Star Wars: Battlefront II|''Battlefront II'']], ''Theta''-class shuttles are titled 'Landing craft' and are armed with two forward-facing cannons, homing missiles and an aft laser-cannon. They are used from the beginning of Imperial rule, until the story mode campaign ends at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

In [[2010]], [[the LEGO Group]] released a set known as "8096 Emperor Palpatine's Shuttle". The set includes movable wings, extendable landing gear, and a medical center with Darth Vader's helmet. The set includes 4 mini figures namely: the redesigned wounded [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] (with helmet), [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] (2008 redesign), [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone Pilot]] (2009 redesign with exclusive headpiece design), and the new minifigure, the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]]. Part of the set's basis could possibly be the 2005 set "7251 Darth Vader Transformation" where Darth Vader is put into his signature suit after he was badly wounded on Mustafar.
